## What and why

<!-- What does this change, and why? One logical change per pull request. -->

## Before merging

- [ ] Read both plan comments: `plan (sandbox)` and `plan (prod)` show what you expect, and nothing else
- [ ] Anything shown as **destroy** is intended (a repository is archived, never deleted; teams and properties refuse to be destroyed)
- [ ] A new GitHub App permission this change needs is granted and accepted in **both** orgs
- [ ] Docs and `docs/naming-conventions.md` are updated where names or behaviour changed

## Only if it applies

- [ ] **Tier or tier rules changed:** the repositories affected, and why their rules change
- [ ] **Something switched on that was configured but off:** the decision that allows it
- [ ] **Templates changed:** publish after merging, sandbox first (`docs/templates.md`)
- [ ] **Follow-up to a fix made by hand in GitHub:** the drift or health issue it closes
